Rashi on Ketubot 15b:10:1.hebrew: לא צריכא כו' - וקא תבע ליה ישראל נזק שלם לתם כדין כנעני, ואשמעינן תנא דכישראל דיינינן ליה ולא משלם אלא חצי נזק, דא"ל אייתי ראיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:10:1.english: [It] is necessary only, etc. - And a Jew is claiming from him full damages for an innocuous [ox] according to the law of a gentile, and the Tanna teaches us that we judge him as a Jew, and he pays only half damages, for he says to him: "Bring proof."

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:1.english: A woman who was widowed or divorced - And [she] is claiming her ketubah.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:2.hebrew: והוא אומר - אנתגרשה קאי, ולאלמנה — היורשין אומרים לה: "אלמנה נשאך אבינו ואין לך אלא מנה". ושטר הכתובה אבד:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:2.english: And he says - [This] refers to [the case where] she was divorced; and for a widow, the heirs say to her: "Our father married you [as] a widow, and you have [a claim to] only a maneh [one hundred zuz]." And the marriage contract document was lost.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:3.hebrew: אם יש עדים - על נשואיה, שיצאת מבית אביה לבית בעלה:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:3.english: If there are witnesses - regarding her wedding, that she went out from her father's house to her husband's house.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:4.english: With a hinnuma - In the Gemara, [it] explains [what this is].

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:5.hebrew: וראשה פרוע - איצטייבליד"ה, שערה על כתיפיה. כך היו נוהגין להוציא את הבתולות מבית אביהן לבית החתונה:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:5.english: And her head is uncovered - [In Old French, eschevelée, meaning] her hair [hanging loose] upon her shoulders. Thus would they customarily bring out virgins from their father's house to the wedding house.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:6.english: Even distribution of roasted grain - They were accustomed to distribute roasted grain to the children at the weddings of virgins.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:7.hebrew: קליות - כשהשבולין לחין, מייבשין אותן בתנור, והן קליות, ומתוקין לעולם:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:12:7.english: Roasted grain - When the ears of grain are moist, they dry them in an oven, and these are kelayot [roasted grain], and they [remain] sweet forever.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:13:1.hebrew: ומודה ר' יהושע - מפרש בגמ' אהיכא קאי, ומאי מודה:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:13:1.english: And Rabbi Yehoshua concedes - It is explained in the Gemara to what [statement] this refers and what [is meant by] "concedes."

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:1:1.english: One found an abandoned baby in it - It is a Mishnah in the Order of Tohorot, regarding a city in which Jews and idolaters reside.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:1:2.hebrew: מחצה על מחצה ישראל - לקמיה מפרש מאי איכא בין רוב ישראל למחצה על מחצה, דפליג להו בתרי:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:1:2.english: Half and half — a Jew - Further on, [the Gemara] explains what [difference] there is between a majority of Jews and half and half, that [the Mishnah] divided them into two [separate cases].

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:1.hebrew: לא שנו - דאם רוב ישראל, ישראל:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:1.english: They did not teach [this] - That if [the] majority are Jews, [he is deemed] a Jew.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:2.hebrew: אלא להחיותו - ב"ד מצווין לפרנסו, משום "וחי אחיך עמך" (ויקרא כ״ה:ל״ו):
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:2.english: Only to sustain him - The court is commanded to support him, because of [the verse], "that your brother may live with you" (Leviticus 25:36).

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:3.hebrew: אבל ליוחסין לא - דאם בת היא, אסורה לכהן. ואפי' ליכא למיחש משום אסופי — כגון הנך דאמרינן בעשרה יוחסין (קדושין עג:): משלטי הדמיה, תלי פיתקא, תלי קמיעא — מיהו חיישינן שמא בת עובד כוכבים היא. ולמ"ד גיורת פסולה לכהונה, אפילו קטנה זו אסורה לכהן, דתרי רובי בעינן ליוחסין:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:3.english: However, for lineage — no - For if [the foundling] is a daughter, she is forbidden to a kohen. And even if there is no [reason] to be concerned about [her being] an asufi [a foundling] — such as those [cases] that we state in [the chapter] Asarah Yuchasin (Kiddushin 73b): [where] its limbs are straightened, a note is hung [on it], [or] an amulet is hung [on it] — nevertheless, we are concerned lest she is the daughter of an idolater. And according to the one who says [that] a female convert is disqualified from [marrying into] the priesthood, even this minor girl is forbidden to a kohen, for we require two majorities for lineage.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:2:4.english: And Shmuel said: Even to clear the heap [of debris] over him - On Shabbat we consider him a Jew.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:3:2.english: That which Rav Yehuda said - For here too there were two majorities.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:1.english: And [according] to Rav Ḥanan bar Rava, who said - In the name of Rav.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:2.hebrew: הוראת שעה היתה - והתם תרי רובי הוו, וקאמר הוראת שעה היתה, אבל לדורות לא בעינן תרי רובי:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:2.english: It was a provisional ruling - And there, there were two majorities, and [yet] he says, "It was a provisional ruling" — [implying that] for [future] generations we do not require two majorities.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:3.hebrew: קשיא הא - דרב דאמר "אבל ליוחסין לא", אלמא רב תרי רובי בעי:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:3.english: This is difficult - [namely, the statement] of Rav, who said, "but for lineage, no," thus [showing that] Rav requires two majorities.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:4.hebrew: לא מתני הא - דאמר רב יהודה אמר רב: בקרונות של צפורי הוה מעשה. וחד רובא הוה, הלכך הוראת שעה היתה:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:4:4.english: Does not teach that - [The statement] that Rav Yehuda said in the name of Rav: "The incident took place among the wagons of Tzippori." [Rather, according to him,] there was [only] one majority; therefore, it was a provisional edict.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:6:1.english: Did Shmuel say this - That regarding saving a life we require a majority?

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:6:2.hebrew: אין הולכין כו' - דאפילו בספק עובד כוכבים ספק ישראל ברוב עובדי כוכבים, מפקחין:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:6:2.english: One does not follow, etc. - For even in [a case of] doubt [whether someone is] a gentile [or] a Jew, [even] with a majority of gentiles, we clear [the debris].

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:6:3.hebrew: ולענין פיקוח נפש אינו כן - דאפילו ברוב עובדי כוכבים מפקחין, דאין הולכין בה אחר הרוב:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:6:3.english: And regarding saving a life, it is not so - For even where there is a majority of idolaters, we clear [the debris], as we do not follow the majority in it.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:7:1.hebrew: למאי הלכתא - כיון דאמר שמואל מפקחין עליו את הגל, אלמא לאו עובד כוכבים הוא לכל מילי, ולמאי הלכתא חשיב ליה עובד כוכבים:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:7:1.english: With regard to what halakha - Since Shmuel said [that] we clear away a heap [of rubble] for him [on Shabbat], thus he is not [considered] an idolater for all matters; so with regard to what halakha does [the Mishnah] consider him an idolater?

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:7:2.hebrew: להאכילו נבלות - בידים, וכ"ש שלא יחזירו לו אבידה ולנזקין:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:7:2.english: To feed him animal carcasses - With [one's own] hands, and all the more so that they do not return a lost item to him, and [also] regarding damages.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:8:1.hebrew: להחזיר לו אבידה - רבותא היא, דמוציאין מיד ישראל הזוכה בה. ועוד, דאמור רבנן (סנהדרין דף עו:): המחזיר אבידה לכנעני, עליו הכתוב אומר: למען ספות הרוה את הצמאה, שהשוה מצרים לחשיבתן של ישראל, ונאמר: לא יאבה ה' סלוח לו:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:8:1.english: To return lost property to him - [This] is a noteworthy ruling, for we extract [it] from the hand of a Jew who acquires it. And furthermore, the Sages said (Sanhedrin 76b): One who returns lost property to a Canaanite, regarding him Scripture says: "To add the watered to the thirsty" — for he equated Egyptians to the importance of Israel — and it is stated: "The Lord will not be willing to forgive him."

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:1.hebrew: מחצה על מחצה ישראל למאי הלכתא - להחזיר לו אבידה, לא מצית אמרת, דא"כ למאי הלכתא פלגינהו מהדדי:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:1.english: Half and half, [he is deemed] a Jew; with regard to what halakha - You cannot say [that it is] to return a lost object to him, for if so, with regard to what halakha did [the Tanna] separate them from one another?

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:2.hebrew: לנזקין - דתנן ב"ק (דף לז:): שור של ישראל שנגח לשור של כנעני — פטור, ושור של כנעני שנגח לשור של ישראל — בין תם בין מועד משלם נזק שלם, וישראל לישראל — תם משלם חצי נזק ומועד משלם נזק שלם:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:2.english: With regard to damages - For we learned in Bava Kamma (37b): [If] an ox of a Jew gored an ox of a Canaanite, [he is] exempt; and [if] an ox of a Canaanite gored an ox of a Jew, whether [it is] innocuous (tam) or forewarned (mu'ad), [he] pays full damages; and [when] a Jew [causes damage] to a Jew, an innocuous [ox] pays half damages, and a forewarned [ox] pays full damages.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:3.hebrew: אילימא כו' - וקאמרת דדיינינן ליה כישראל, ומחייבת ליה לשלם לו חצי נזקו:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:3.english: If we say, etc. - And you say that we judge him as a Jew, and you obligate [the Jewish owner] to pay him half his damage.

Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:4.hebrew: לימא ליה - ישראל: אייתי ראיה, דהא מחצה על מחצה הוא וספיקא הוא:
Rashi on Ketubot 15b:9:4.english: Let him say to him - [Let] the Jew [say to him]: "Bring proof," for it is half-and-half and it is a matter of doubt.

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:10:1.hebrew: לא צריכא דנגחיה תורא דידיה כו' - תימה, דהכי נמי הוה מצי למימר: "מחצה על מחצה — עובד כוכבים", ומנגח תורא דידן לתורא דידיה [כולה מילתא הוי מצי למימר לענין נגיחה, אלא ניחא בכל חד למצוא דבר חדש. מהר"ם]:
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:10:1.english: It is necessary only where his ox gored, etc. - It is puzzling, for [the Gemara] could equally have said: "Half and half — [he is deemed] a gentile," and [a case where] our ox gored his ox. [It could have stated the entire matter with respect to goring, but it preferred to find something new in each one. Maharam.]

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:12:1.hebrew: האשה. אם יש עדים שיצאת בהינומא כו' - בדלא נקיטא כתובה איירי, דאי איכא כתובה — ניחזי כתובתה אם היא בתולה או אלמנה. ואפילו למ"ד הטוען אחר מעשה ב"ד ואמר "פרעתי" נאמן, מ"מ אין נאמן לומר כאן "אלמנה נשאתיך" מגו דאי בעי אמר "פרעתי", דמגו במקום עדים הוא:
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:12:1.english: The woman [who was widowed]... If there are witnesses that she went out with a hinnuma, etc. - [The Mishnah] is speaking of [a case] where she is not holding [her] ketubah, for if there were a ketubah, let us examine her ketubah [to see] whether she is [listed as] a virgin or a widow. And even according to the one who says [that] one who makes a claim against a court enactment and says, "I have paid," is believed, nevertheless he is not believed to say here, "I married you [as] a widow," with a migo that if he wanted he could have said, "I have paid," for it is a migo in the face of witnesses.

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:13:1.hebrew: ומודה רבי יהושע באומר שדה כו' דנאמן - מתוך פירוש הקונט' משמע דדוקא כשאין הלה תובעו, ונאמן במגו דאי בעי שתיק, אבל אם תובעו — אינו נאמן. ואינו נראה, דהא קתני סיפא: "ואם יש עדים כו'" — משמע דדוקא אם יש עדים שהיתה של אביו אינו נאמן, אבל אם אין עדים, אע"ג דהלה תובעו — נאמן, מגו דאי בעי אמר "לא היתה של אביך מעולם", מדלא נקט "אם תובעו אינו נאמן". ובגמרא נמי פריך: "וליתני שדה זו שלך היתה?" — משמע דבהלה תובעו איירי, ולכך משיב "ודאי שלך היתה ולקחתיה ממך"; אבל אם לא תובעו, אין שייך לומר "שלך היתה", כי מסתמא הוא יודע בעצמו דבר זה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:13:1.english: And Rabbi Yehoshua concedes in [a case where] one says, "A field, etc." that he is deemed credible - From Rashi's commentary it is implied that [this applies] specifically when the other [party] is not claiming [the field] from him, and he is deemed credible through a migo [argument], since if he wanted he could have remained silent; however, if [the other party] is claiming [it] from him, he is not deemed credible. But this does not appear [correct], for the latter clause teaches: "And if there are witnesses, etc." — [which] implies that specifically if there are witnesses that it belonged to his father he is not deemed credible, whereas if there are no witnesses, even though the other [party] is claiming [it] from him, he is deemed credible, [by] a migo that if he wanted he could have said, "It never belonged to your father," since [the Mishnah] did not state, "If he claims [it] from him, he is not deemed credible." And in the Gemara as well, [the Gemara] asks: "And let it teach, 'This field was yours'?" — [which] implies that [the Mishnah] is dealing with [a case where] the other [party] is claiming [it] from him, and therefore he replies, "Certainly it was yours and I purchased it from you"; whereas if he were not claiming [it] from him, it would not be relevant to say "It was yours," since presumably he knows this matter himself.

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:4:1.hebrew: ולרב חנן דאמר הוראת שעה היתה - ולדורות סגי בחד רובא, קשיא הך. ולא מיסתברא ליה למימר דהוראת שעה היתה שהתיר בתרי רובי, אבל לדורות לא סגי אפילו בתרי רובי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:4:1.english: And according to Rav Ḥanan, who said, "It was a temporary ruling" - [meaning that] for [future] generations one majority suffices, this [statement] is difficult. And it did not seem reasonable to [the Gemara] to say that it was a temporary ruling in that he permitted [her] with two majorities, whereas for [future] generations even two majorities do not suffice.

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:4:2.hebrew: מאן דמתני הא לא מתני הא - פי' בקונטרס דרב חנן לא מתני דבקרונות של צפורי היה מעשה, ולא הוה אלא חד רובא. ולפירושו לא פליגי, דלדורות לכ"ע בעינן תרי רובי, ולא פליגי אלא במעשה היכי הוה. ור"ח פי' דרב חנן לא מתני "אבל ליוחסין לא", וסגי לדידיה לדורות בחד רובא. אבל קשה לפירושו: לרב חנן תקשי ר' יוחנן בן נורי, דאמר כמאן דסגי בחד רובא, כדפריך לעיל; ועוד, דלא מיסתבר דשום אמורא יחלוק אההיא ד"אבל ליוחסין לא", דרב גופיה קאמר לה בלא אמורא. ולהכי אפירכא דרבי ירמיה לא משני "מאן דמתני הא לא מתני הא":
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:4:2.english: "The one who teaches this does not teach that" - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained that Rav Ḥanan does not teach that the incident took place among the wagons of Tzippori, and [according to him] there was only one majority. And according to his explanation, they do not disagree [on the halakha], for regarding future generations, according to everyone we require two majorities; they only disagree about how the incident occurred. And Rabbeinu Ḥananel explained that Rav Ḥanan does not teach "[However, with regard to] lineage, no," and according to him, one majority suffices for future generations. However, [this is] difficult according to his explanation: according to Rav Ḥanan, Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri should pose a difficulty, for he spoke in accordance with the one who holds that one majority suffices, as [the Gemara] asked above; and furthermore, it is not reasonable that any Amora would disagree with that [statement] of "[However, with regard to] lineage, no," for Rav himself stated it without an Amora [reporting it in his name]. And for this reason, in response to the objection of Rabbi Yirmiyah, [the Gemara] does not answer, "The one who teaches this does not teach that."

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:7:1.hebrew: אם רוב עובדי כוכבים עובד כוכבים למאי הלכתא - לא מצי למימר לענין שלא להחיותו, דמאי איריא רוב עובדי כוכבים? אפילו מחצה נמי, דדוקא ברוב ישראל קאמר רב דהוי ישראל להחיותו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:7:1.english: If [there is] a majority of idolaters, [he is] an idolater; with regard to what halakha? - [The Gemara] could not say [that this is] with regard to not sustaining him, for why specifically [when there is] a majority of idolaters? Even [when it is] half [and half] as well [we would not sustain him], for it was specifically when [there is] a majority of Jews that Rav said he is [considered] a Jew to sustain him.

Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:8:1.hebrew: להחזיר לו אבדה - הוה מצי למימר להחיותו כדאמר רב, אלא נקט להחזיר לו אבדה דהוי רבותא טפי — דאיסור גדול הוא משום "למען ספות הרוה" וגו'; אבל להחיותו לא הוי רבותא כל כך, דהא מפרנסין עניי עובדי כוכבים עם עניי ישראל. ואפי' לשמואל דאמר "אין הולכין בממון אחר הרוב", היינו במוכר שור לחבירו ונמצא נגחן, שבהיתר באו המעות לידו ומדעתו נתנם לו הלוקח; אבל הכא מודי דאזלינן בתר רובא:
Tosafot on Ketubot 15b:8:1.english: To return lost property to him - [Rav Pappa] could have said "to sustain him," as Rav said [earlier], but he chose "to return lost property to him" because it is a greater novelty — for it is a severe prohibition because of [the verse], "to add drunkenness [to thirst]," etc.; whereas "to sustain him" would not be such a great novelty, since we support the poor of the idolaters together with the poor of Israel. And even according to Shmuel, who said [that] we do not follow the majority in monetary matters, that is [only] in the case of one who sells an ox to his fellow and it is found to be a gorer, where the money came into his possession permissibly and the buyer gave it to him willingly; but here, he agrees that we follow the majority.
